events.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping things off at the community center this afternoon, and they’re especially looking for tools and spare parts.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Mara: That’s good to know — I can swing by the community center this afternoon and drop off a few spare parts if they’re still collecting.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Hana: That should be perfect — just check with the center when you get there so you know they’re still taking them.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Mina: Hi Hana—what’s the latest on the repair drive, and do you need anything from me?

events.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I’m still checking the details on the repair drive, so I don’t want to guess yet. If you have the latest list of needed items, send it over and I’ll compare it with what’s already covered.

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ve got the time. If you can send the latest list of what’s still needed, I’ll check it and help from there.
